_comment: Third-party inputs for the weapons & props generator. fetch_sources.py downloads these into tools/_cache/weapons/ (git-ignored) and records author/licence metadata; build_all.py turns that metadata into assets/credits/weapons_props.json. Only CC0 / CC BY sources are allowed (docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md).

dark_wood.used_for: Gun stocks, pistol grips and fore-ends

coated_pine.used_for: Light pine parts: launcher grips, crate battens, cradle, glider handle

rough_wood.used_for: Weathered garden-crate slats (loot crate, supply drop)

metal_plate_02.used_for: Blued / worn steel and brass fittings (tinted)

green_metal_rust.used_for: Chipped painted sheet metal (hue-shifted to carrot orange / sage)

hessian_380.used_for: Jute twine wraps, burlap pouch and shoulder pads

caban.used_for: Patchwork envelope panels (orange wool), dropship balloon

fabric_pattern_07.used_for: Red picnic-check panels and basket lining, dropship balloon

gingham_check.used_for: Green gingham envelope panels, dropship balloon

waffle_pique_cotton.used_for: Yellow waffle-cotton envelope panels, dropship balloon

fabric_pattern_05.used_for: Cream windowpane-plaid envelope panels, dropship balloon

oak_veneer_01.used_for: Oak planks of the treasure chests

studio_small_09.used_for: Lighting for preview renders only (not shipped inside any glb)

carrot_scan.used_for: Photoscanned carrot skin: unwrapped by prep_scans.py into a carrot-skin strip (albedo + normal) used on every carrot surface

acorn_scan.used_for: Photoscanned acorn: unwrapped by prep_scans.py into cupule-scale and nut-shell strips (albedo + normal) for the acorn helmet and acorn-shell armour

maple_leaf_scan.used_for: Red maple leaf scan, re-skinned by a top-down planar bake into an alpha leaf texture for glider_maple_leaf

oak_leaf.used_for: Red oak autumn leaf (single leaf card), re-skinned by a top-down planar bake into the alpha leaf texture of glider_oak_leaf

tulip_scan.used_for: Red tulip scan, unwrapped into a petal colour strip for glider_tulip

parasol_scan.used_for: Shaggy parasol mushroom scan, re-skinned by a top-down planar bake into the scaly cap texture of glider_mushroom

FlowerSet001.used_for: Daisy heads (colour + opacity + normal) for the glider_daisy petal canopy
